title: Static four-charge squashed black hole in five-dimensional $STU-W^2U$ supergravity and its thermodynamics
summary: In this paper, we present a remarkably simple expression for the exact solution to the $D = 5$, $\mathcal{N} = 2$ supergravity coupled to three vector multiplets with the prepotential $\mathcal{V} = STU -W^2U \equiv 1$, which represents a five-dimensional static Kaluza-Klein black hole with squashed $S^3$ horizons and four independent electric charges. It is asymptotically locally flat and has a spatial infinity $R \times S^1 \hookrightarrow S^2$.
